summary.scope: Complete staged result for this finite read suite. The approved missing-readable-memory ERROR class counts as expected; not all ERROR classes do. Primary universal verification is reused separately.

metrics.timing_scope: Execution measurements reused from unchanged source/input hashes; ITP independently measured per required test execution, all attempts included.
metrics.memory_scope: Largest measured local process resident memory across independent execution ITP runs; not a sum or divided batch peak.
metrics.sharing_policy: One independent ITP per required test execution; no cross-case model call or kernel replay sharing.
metrics.reuse_scope: Only the checked concrete-heap helper is reused; separately recompiled within each execution. One isolated model proof task and independent kernel replay per execution; all attempts counted.
metrics.stage_accounting_note: Disjoint measured stages: generation/execution, agent proof filling, Coq compilation/audit, independent kernel check. Generation includes native automatic processing; no finer timing was collected. Agent wall time is the measured CLI invocation, not remote inference alone. Independent per-execution work is summed once; legacy shared batch counted once.

itp_stage.shared_stages: Each execution has its own model task, helper/goal/proof compilation and independent kernel replay; all attempts counted.
